title: How to Break off an Engagement

stops.text: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · A Tambourine through the chapel window — “Ode to forever—”
3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · B The empty temple — “empty choir stands,”
3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · C Gifts at the side doors — “spirits have / left salvations”
3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · D The storm — “it thunders.”
3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · E Remnants on the shore — “Ode to the storm ending.”
3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · F Tambourine shatters — “& a tambourine / shattered into pieces.”
